description: Turn a 1lev1.com page into a link to give the user - it does not open anything by itself. Pass the path (e.g. "/lev", or "/moach/<projectId>" with idPr) and a short name for it; the result carries the path to put after https://1lev1.com. getSitePagesTool lists the valid paths. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#navigateToPageTool

idPr.description: The ID of the project to navigate to, if applicable.

pageName.description: A descriptive name for the page being navigated to.

url.description: The URL path to navigate to.

name: navigateToPageTool
